C0483.title: 15-Year-Old Boy Uses Mother's Identity to Top Up Games
C0483.summary: In October 2024, a 15-year-old middle school student surnamed Xu bypassed an online game's anti-addiction system by registering and logging in with his mother's identity information, then secretly used her WeChat account to top up nearly 5,000 yuan. After his mother discovered the charges, she sued for a full refund. The court ultimately ordered the platform to return only a portion of the funds.

references.title: Boy repeatedly uses mother's identity to top up games, parents sue platform for refund
